title: The Man in the Bee Suit

beats.voiceover: Right now, you're standing in a five-star hotel lobby wearing a puffy white bee suit. You're hugging a buzzing wooden box—and two masked robbers are aiming pistols at your chest.
beats.visual: A man in a puffy white beekeeper suit hugs a wooden hive box in a marble hotel lobby while two masked robbers point pistols at him.

beats.voiceover: Yeah, you're definitely not a secret agent. One hour ago, you were just the friendly neighborhood beekeeper delivering a fresh hive to the hotel's rooftop garden.
beats.visual: A smiling beekeeper in a white suit carries a wooden box through a sunlit hotel service entrance.

beats.voiceover: Then the service elevator stopped on floor four. Two guys in dark ski masks were arguing over the vault code—and froze solid the instant they spotted you standing quietly behind them. One reached straight under his jacket.
beats.visual: Two men in dark jackets and masks spin sharply inside a hotel elevator to stare at the stunned beekeeper behind them.

beats.voiceover: Seconds later the doors chimed open and you bolted like your life depended on it. Still zipped tight in your thick white suit, still clutching that wooden box—until they cornered you right beside the lobby fountain.
beats.visual: The beekeeper sprints out of an open elevator into a grand lobby clutching the wooden box with two angry robbers chasing close behind.

beats.voiceover: Now the bigger robber barks, "Drop the act and open the box!" He's totally convinced you're smuggling hotel diamonds. So you shrug, flip the brass latch, and tip the lid wide open. Ten thousand furious bees explode straight into their faces. Guns fly, grown men shriek like toddlers, and both sprint out the doors—while you grin safely behind your mesh suit.
beats.visual: A massive swirling cloud of bees pours from the open wooden box as two shrieking robbers drop their guns and bolt out the hotel doors.

beats.voiceover: Right now, you're frozen stiff in a dark museum wrapped in a white bedsheet. Gray plaster dust cakes your nose—and two armed thieves are walking straight toward you.
beats.visual: A motionless figure wrapped in a white sheet with gray dusty skin stands on a marble pedestal as two armed burglars walk closer.

beats.voiceover: You're definitely not a priceless Roman statue. Twenty minutes ago, you were just the overnight janitor mopping tile floors with music playing in your ears.
beats.visual: A cheerful night janitor in a blue shirt mops a gleaming museum gallery floor beside rows of stone statues.

beats.voiceover: Then you heard glass shatter down the main gallery. You peeked round the corner and saw two masked burglars lifting a solid gold crown. One spun around and locked eyes on you.
beats.visual: Two masked burglars lift a gleaming gold crown from a shattered glass display case as one snaps his head toward the peeking janitor.

beats.voiceover: Seconds later you bolted into the closed repair wing with zero exit doors. You spotted a white drop sheet, a sack of gray dust, and one empty stone block. Crazy plan? Maybe.
beats.visual: Inside a dim restoration room, the janitor snatches a white drop sheet beside an open bag of gray dust and an empty marble pedestal.

beats.voiceover: Now their flashlights sweep down the statues—and stop dead on your face. One thief leans inches away, squinting hard. Gray dust tickles your nose and you're fighting the sneeze of your life, praying your sheet doesn't twitch. Finally he scoffs, "Man, that one's hideous," and turns away—so you quietly hop down and slam the red alarm.
beats.visual: A squinting burglar shines a flashlight inches from the dusty motionless face wrapped in a sheet, then shakes his head and walks away.

beats.voiceover: Right now, you're dangling twenty stories high on a thin rope outside a glass skyscraper. Bright red paint drips off your hands while twelve cops yell below, "Don't move!"
beats.visual: A window painter dangles from a rope high on a glass skyscraper with bright red paint dripping from his hands while police cars swarm below.

beats.voiceover: Relax—you didn't rob anybody. Three hours earlier, you were just a building painter whistling along to the radio while touching up the rooftop trim.
beats.visual: A relaxed painter in white coveralls ties his safety rope on a sunny skyscraper roof beside a bright red paint bucket.

beats.voiceover: Then as you lowered past floor twenty, you glanced through an office window. Two suited guys were cracking open a wall safe—and one spotted your boots right outside.
beats.visual: Through a twentieth-floor office window, two suited burglars pull cash bundles from an open safe as one looks straight at the painter outside.

beats.voiceover: Seconds later he shoved the window wide open with a sharp utility knife and started sawing right through your rope! You kicked off the glass, slid a full story down, and dumped your whole can of red paint across your gloves.
beats.visual: A suited burglar reaches out a high window sawing at the safety rope as the painter kicks clear and red paint splashes over his gloves.

beats.voiceover: Now the cops below think you're the burglar—and twenty floors up, nobody can hear you yelling over the sirens. So you grip the rope tight with one hand and dunk your palm in paint. You smear a giant red arrow across the glass pointing straight up. Twelve officers squint upward—right as two panicked crooks on floor twenty drop their cash bags.
beats.visual: Hanging by one hand on the rope, the painter smears a giant red arrow pointing upward across the glass while officers below look up.
